roles.finding: Use m>=2 path for S_{2Lambda}; keep the deterministic n term and S_gamma ledger separate.

roles.background: conditional convergence, Abel/partial summation, ordered series
roles.delegated_check: Audit source-order legality of every prefix/suffix operation.
roles.finding: Q and G are finite natural-order functionals; no rearrangement is used. Infinite-tail authority remains inherited shadow only.

roles.delegated_check: Detect hidden use of fixed-x or nonuniform Laguerre asymptotics.
roles.finding: The proposed discriminator is algebraic and uses no Laguerre asymptotic estimate; this avoids reopening the R5 envelope issue.

roles.background: decomposition, complements, compatibility and proof DAGs
roles.delegated_check: Identify the exact complement needed to transport a local statistic to the endpoint.
roles.finding: The missing coordinate is suffix drawdown G; Q+G bounds the finite endpoint, then E handles the external tail.

roles.delegated_check: Construct hostile paths and test endpoint-inclusive versus strict-interior definitions.
roles.finding: Endpoint-inclusive Q is not local; strict-interior Q admits a path-space witness with identical prefix statistic and arbitrarily different endpoint, but this is not arithmetic attainability.

roles.delegated_check: Recheck Coffey, Voros, and current 2026 zero-free literature; reject scope overreach.
roles.finding: Coffey/Voros support only the root-sensitive coordinate/context. Bellotti-Trudgian-Yang 2026 is current but downstream and not needed for the structural candidate.

roles.background: RAKL v3 TaskEpisode, semantic-shortcut gate, authority and telemetry
roles.finding: Proceed only as proposal/shadow GLUE candidate; same-context cell earns zero independent-review credit.

discussion_synthesis: The cell rejected the whole-prefix running excursion because endpoint inclusion defeats the requested DifferenceWitness.
The cell selected a strict internal cutoff and required the suffix drawdown to remain a first-class gluing residual.
The cell agreed that an arbitrary signed-path witness is sufficient to refute an algebraic identity but insufficient to establish target arithmetic attainability.
No member authorizes RH promotion, novelty authority, or independent-review credit.
